dict.string: SWEEPR Cleaner scans your Desktop folder locally to locate duplicate files and reclaim disk space.
SWEEPR Cleaner scans your Documents folder locally to locate duplicate files, stale developer artifacts, and large files.
SWEEPR Cleaner scans your Downloads folder locally to locate old unused installers and duplicate files.
SWEEPR Cleaner uses system permissions to inspect protected application caches and reclaim storage safely.
